column1: # Character-level Hán Việt corrections: which reading a character has, by traditional form and pinyin
# Drafted by Claude (AI), 2026-09. status "ai-draft" = AI-drafted, awaiting human review ("hiệu đính bởi AI, chờ duyệt");
# "reviewed" = checked by the project owner ("đã hiệu đính") — only the owner sets it. Changes: CHANGELOG.md.
# Format: UTF-8 (NFC), LF, tab-separated. Lines starting with "#" are comments.
# char: the traditional form (the build reads Hán Việt from it). pinyin: CC-CEDICT numbered, lowercase, or "*" for every reading.
# hanviet: the readings to use instead of hanviet-pinyin-words', "|"-separated, the first one shipped, the others searchable
# alternates. vernacular: forms that must never ship as this character's reading ("|"-separated, "-" for none) — the build's
# hv-vernacular gate checks every row, curated word readings included.
# Found by a scan of the word list's first candidates: characters whose shipped reading is a word of their own Vietnamese gloss
# (冷 lạnh "lạnh") with no compound confirming it as Sino-Vietnamese, and every character of an HSK word the list gives several
# readings for; then checked by hand. Unihan kVietnamese cannot be the check: it lists the same vernacular forms.
